description: This file defines various data structures, types, and constants related to decentralized identifiers (DIDs), verifiable credentials (VCs), and their management within a software system. It includes definitions for registry entries, DID info, credentials, filters, registration requests/responses, and components for DID lifecycle management and verification.

classes.name: DIDRegistry
classes.description: Represents the master DID registry for an agent or server, containing core identification and key management info.

classes.name: AgentDIDInfo
classes.description: Contains DID details for an agent node, including keys, status, and associated reasoners and skills.

classes.name: ReasonerDIDInfo
classes.description: Holds DID information for a reasoner component within an agent.

classes.name: SkillDIDInfo
classes.description: Holds DID info for a skill component.

classes.name: AgentDIDStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of possible statuses for an agent DID (active, inactive, revoked).

classes.name: ExecutionVC
classes.description: Represents a verifiable credential for an execution instance.

classes.name: WorkflowVC
classes.description: A verifiable credential for a workflow or process.

classes.name: DIDIdentityPackage
classes.description: A collection of a DID identity and associated reasoner and skill DIDs for an agent.

classes.name: DIDIdentity
classes.description: A personal DID with associated cryptographic keys and metadata.

classes.name: ExecutionContext
classes.description: Holds context info for executing DID-enabled workflows or actions.

classes.name: VCDocument
classes.description: Represents a complete verifiable credential document including proof and subject info.

classes.name: WorkflowVCDocument
classes.description: Verifiable credential document specific to workflows.

classes.name: VCCredentialSubject
classes.description: Subject data for a VC related to execution, target, and auditing info.

classes.name: WorkflowVCCredentialSubject
classes.description: Subject portion for workflow-level VC, with aggregation details.

classes.name: VCCaller
classes.description: Information about the caller in a VC context.

classes.name: VCTarget
classes.description: Details about the target entity in a VC.

classes.name: VCExecution
classes.description: Execution metadata within a VC, including hash and timestamps.

classes.name: VCAudit
classes.description: Audit info associated with a VC.

classes.name: VCProof
classes.description: Cryptographic proof information for a VC.

classes.name: DIDFilters
classes.description: Filtering criteria for querying DIDs.

classes.name: VCFilters
classes.description: Filtering criteria for querying verifiable credentials.

classes.name: DIDRegistrationRequest
classes.description: Request payload for registering a new agent DID with associated reasoners and skills.

classes.name: DIDRegistrationResponse
classes.description: Response containing registration success and identity package.

classes.name: VCVerificationRequest
classes.description: Request for verifying a VC document.

classes.name: VCVerificationResponse
classes.description: Result of VC verification including validity and issuer info.

classes.name: WorkflowVCChainRequest
classes.description: Request to fetch a chain of VCs for a workflow.

classes.name: WorkflowVCChainResponse
classes.description: Response with the chain's VCs and details, optionally including a DID resolution bundle.

classes.name: WorkflowVCStatusAggregation
classes.description: Aggregated VC statistics for a workflow directly from database.

classes.name: WorkflowVCStatusSummary
classes.description: UI-friendly summary of VC status for a workflow.

classes.name: DefaultWorkflowVCStatusSummary
classes.description: Function to create an empty default summary.

classes.name: DIDResolutionEntry
classes.description: Resolved DID info with associated public key for offline verification.

classes.name: DIDRegistryEntry
classes.description: Represents an entry in the DID registry with associated document and metadata.

classes.name: ComponentDIDInfo
classes.description: DID information for components like reasoners or skills.

classes.name: ExecutionVCInfo
classes.description: Stores info about execution VCs in the database.

classes.name: WorkflowVCInfo
classes.description: Stores info about workflow VCs in the database.

classes.name: AgentFieldServerDIDInfo
classes.description: DID info stored for the agent field server.

classes.name: RegistrationType
classes.description: Enumeration for registration operation types: new, update, force update.

classes.name: EnhancedDIDRegistrationRequest
classes.description: Extended request structure for registering DIDs with registration type and overwrite option.

classes.name: DifferentialAnalysisResult
classes.description: Results of comparing existing and new reasoners/skills for updates.

classes.name: PartialDIDRegistrationRequest
classes.description: Request for partial registration/update of reasoners and skills.

classes.name: ComponentDeregistrationRequest
classes.description: Request payload for deregistering components from an agent.

classes.name: PartialDIDRegistrationResponse
classes.description: Response for partial registration/update including counts and identity package.

classes.name: ComponentDeregistrationResponse
classes.description: Response after deregistering components, indicating success and count.
